text_block_list.text:
A photoshoot in racing silks.
That was why I came to the racetrack with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf-san!
Thank you for your hard work today!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work.
And thank you very much for taking such wonderful photos.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm the one who should be thanking you.
It was an honor to be involved in photographing the "Emperor"!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Right here... These are today's samples.
They came out beautifully, so please take a look if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —It is customary for an Umamusume who dons her racing silks to send photos of herself looking her best to her parents or close friends.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A proud attire meant for standing on a once-in-a-lifetime grand stage.
In the sense of sharing the joy of donning it, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I was also wondering a bit
whether I should send some to my parents.
choice_data_list: You should just see them home.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I had my reasons.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I haven't really
told you much about my family—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My parents are—passionate and rigorous. They are people who would throw themselves into the fire to better the world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, she was strict with me, her child, as well—
wishing for me to become a great leader.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't misunderstand me,
I have the utmost respect for my parents."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am truly grateful to you for raising me with strictness greater than anyone else's, yet with high expectations all the same.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I too sought my own calling, found it
on the racetrack, and entered Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "However, as you well know, I am still only halfway there. Far from the figure my parents would have wished to see—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘Having mixed feelings’—
In short, that's what it means."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if I sent a photo of myself having accomplished
nothing yet, would my parents really be happy...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...And so,
I ended up pondering things totally out of character for me.
choice_data_list: We can just make it a "progress report."
I kind of want to see you get scolded for once~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
It's all in how you say it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Just as you say, let's make this a progress report.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If I am scolded as half-baked—
I shall simply accept it."
Later on, Symboli Rudolf mentioned that she had received a letter from her parents.

Supposedly, the letter contained the expected harsh words...
along with a brief note of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I'm quite ordinary myself.
Finding it this difficult to suppress a broad smile, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for giving me that push,
Trainer.

As Symboli Rudolf smiled, it felt as though
a bit of tension had melted from her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
You say the most peculiar things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, indeed, I might be able to show you the expression you so desire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I think I'll try sending the photo.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If they call us half-baked—
it wouldn't be so bad to share a knowing grin between the two of us."
Later on, Symboli Rudolf mentioned that she had received a letter from her parents.

Supposedly, the letter contained the expected harsh words...
along with a brief note of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good grief.
I had intended to show a face full of remorse, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well now. The corners of my mouth keep turning up,
so it's not going very well.
choice_data_list: That's a rare look for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Good grief, I'm truly no match for you.

As Symboli Rudolf smiled, it felt as though
a bit of tension had melted from her shoulders.
